Review a change in this worktree. `git diff origin/main` shows it: PR 159, "report a pure file
rename in the semantic diff", reconstructed on top of current main (which already contains PR 167's
index-policy work). It adds pathScopeChange() and calls it when moduleScopeChange() declines.

REFUTE the claims below. I may be wrong. Per claim: WRONG (cite file:line) or CONFIRMED with
evidence. Then a MISSED-DEFECTS section for anything I have not listed.

CLAIM 1: The fix is correct in principle - a pure rename re-identifies every symbol in the file
because the path is a component of the compound-v1 symbol ID, so an empty diff is wrong.

CLAIM 2: The guard `oldPath == "" || oldPath == path` is right, and `oldPath == ""` is DEAD code
because the call site substitutes path for an empty OldPath before calling.

CLAIM 3: The only realistic inputs reaching the new branch are (a) a rename/copy with identical
bytes and (b) a chmod-only change. Oversized, missing, unreadable, non-blob, unaddressable and
unsupported-extension files all `continue` earlier, and a typechange with identical bytes either
parse-errors or is excluded from the graph.

CLAIM 4: (type="moved", kind="module") is a NEW pair. Before this change, "moved" was only produced
with a real entity kind, and moduleKind only with added/removed/body_changed.

CLAIM 5: The FileChange.language for a byte-identical cross-extension rename (mod.js -> mod.ts) is
wrong - it reports JavaScript while the head snapshot calls mod.ts TypeScript - but this is
PRE-EXISTING, not introduced here: current main mislabels the same rename when it carries an edit.
The root cause is the `if language == "" { language = afterLanguage }` fallback, not the new branch.

CLAIM 6: The change cannot cause double-reporting or interfere with PR 167's admitChangedFiles
rewrites (which convert cross-policy-boundary renames into D/A entries with OldPath cleared).

Constraints: read-only. Do NOT run the Go test suite (>10 min). Use rg/sed/git to read.
Concise: verdict + evidence per claim, then MISSED-DEFECTS.

I’ll audit each claim against the reconstructed diff and current-main behavior, using the graph only to locate the relevant code, then focused `git`/`sed` reads. I’ll keep this read-only and won’t run the Go suite.

content.text:
## Claims

1. **CONFIRMED.** `compound-v1` IDs include the file path ([provider.go:23622](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/provider.go:23622)). Entity comparison ignores paths and matches by kind/name/content ([analyze.go:888](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:888)), so a byte-identical rename previously produced no entity or module change.

2. **CONFIRMED.** The production call normalizes empty `OldPath` to `path` first ([analyze.go:207](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:207)); therefore `oldPath == ""` is unreachable at the sole call. `oldPath == path` correctly suppresses chmod/same-path changes ([analyze.go:1264](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:1264)).

3. **WRONG.** Copies do not reach this branch: current discovery enables renames, not copies ([git.go:603](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/gitutil/git.go:603)), and any future `C` entry is rewritten to an `A` with `OldPath` cleared ([analyze.go:1076](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:1076)). Conversely, an identical-byte typechange can reach it: status `T` is retained with no old path ([git.go:622](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/gitutil/git.go:622)), and the reader accepts any Git blob regardless of mode ([git.go:1887](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/gitutil/git.go:1887)). A regular-file↔symlink typechange with the same valid source payload need neither parse-error nor be excluded; it reaches `pathScopeChange`, which then declines because the path is unchanged. The listed read/support failures do indeed continue earlier ([analyze.go:327](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:327)).

4. **WRONG.** The synthetic producer is new, but the wire pair is not. Existing move reconciliation copies `a.entity.Kind` into a `"moved"` change ([analyze.go:805](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:805)), while parsers already emit real entities with kind `"module"`—for example Perl and Erlang modules ([parser.go:4489](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/parser.go:4489)). Thus a real module moved across files could already produce `moved/module`.

5. **CONFIRMED**, with one nuance: this patch newly exposes the bug for previously-absent pure renames, but the selection logic is pre-existing. `.js` and `.ts` resolve to different languages ([parser.go:95](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/parser.go:95)), yet the old-side language wins unless empty ([analyze.go:364](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:364)). Any edited rename already emitted a delta carrying that old language ([analyze.go:423](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:423)).

6. **CONFIRMED.** The fallback runs only when changes, removals, and additions are all empty and adds exactly one change ([analyze.go:403](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:403)). PR 167’s boundary rewrites produce `D`/`A` entries without `OldPath` ([analyze.go:1087](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:1087)); those are consumed as module `removed`/`added` before `pathScopeChange` ([analyze.go:1286](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:1286)).

## MISSED-DEFECTS

- **Stale/ambiguous reconciliation contract.** `EntityChange.Reconciliation` still says it is populated only when a delete+add pair was reconciled ([model.go:68](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/model.go:68)), but `pathScopeChange` now assigns `MOVED` directly ([analyze.go:1268](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze.go:1268)). Because real module moves share the same `moved/module` pair, consumers cannot use that pair alone to identify the new file-scope sentinel.

- **Misleading test coverage.** `TestAnalyzeGitRangeUnchangedFileStaysAbsent` changes only `other.go` and therefore never sends `sample.go` through `pathScopeChange` ([analyze_test.go:2102](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-thomi-Projects-entire-graph/5cd65790-57b7-4cde-b499-c3530b55792b/scratchpad/wt159/internal/sem/analyze_test.go:2102)). The chmod test is the actual same-path fallback coverage.

`git diff --check origin/main` is clean. Go tests were not run, per constraint.
